problems.title: Invariant: Informational vs normative

body.md: Sherif's light task was unclear. Asch's line task was clear. Predict which study leaves people truly believing the group and which makes them go along only in public. Explain using how clear the task is.

problems.how: Predict it and say why, in your own words.

proof.reference: In Sherif's study the task was unclear, so people used the group as information. They came to truly believe the group's guess. In Asch's study the lines were clear, so people knew the group was wrong. They went along in public to avoid being laughed at, but did not change their minds.
must: unclear task means informational influence and private acceptance
clear task means normative influence and public compliance only

problems.title: Invariant: Obedience factors

body.md: In a Milgram-style study, change one thing at a time. First, the experimenter says, I am responsible for anything that happens to him. Second, the study moves from a famous university to a shabby office. Predict obedience for each change. Explain why.

problems.how: Predict it and say why, in your own words.
